property_summary: After a successful withdrawGovernanceAsset call, the pending flash governance decision for (targetContract, msg.sender) is cleared, so c.pendingFlashDecision(targetContract,user).amount() == 0; the mutant never deletes it, leaving the amount nonzero after withdrawal.
change_summary: Remove the `delete pendingFlashDecision[targetContract][msg.sender];` statement so the pending decision is not cleared, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same staked amount.
